entry.title: New topic page: New Standardisation Regulation – routes to presumption of conformity
entry.summary: On 6 October 2026 the Commission proposed a new Standardisation Regulation (COM(2026) 780) to replace Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012.

entry.title: New topic page: High-risk suppliers
entry.summary: "High-risk supplier" is on its way to becoming a horizontal eligibility filter in EU law: it would decide who may supply key ICT assets of essential and important entities, take part in public procurement and auctions, receive public support and EU funding, and take part in European standardisation, certification and conformity assessment.
